generation.asset_base: Runner supplies the existing original-checkout .research-runs directory; no download.
generation.distribution_scope: New process-local named distribution only; preserve installed package and default distribution.
generation.OOD_disclosure: 44 atoms is outside the native1-20 atom sampling/training-size domain. Chemical-system conditioning does not enforce stoichiometry or apatite topology; this is an adaptation feasibility pilot, not established HAP generation.

budgets.parallelism: B/C select concurrency from measured host/GPU headroom and existing protections; parallelism does not multiply the total compute allowance.

reference.ordering_provenance: workflow/local_compute.py:prepare; retain the documented parallel OH ordering. Do not treat partially occupied CIF sites as44 fully occupied atoms.
reference.control_status: Computational reference, not a human-certified publication reference. Reuse existing file without regenerating it.

hard_gates.distance_definition: Nearest periodic contacts including distinct atoms and nonzero self-images; exclude only the zero self-distance. Do not use Cartesian distances without PBC.

necessary_extra_connectivity: The2 H atoms have2 distinct hydroxyl O neighbors.
Each of24 phosphate O atoms belongs to exactly1 P tetrahedron; the2 hydroxyl O atoms are outside those tetrahedra.
local_geometry.periodic_images: Count periodic image neighbors reliably. If nearest-image-only code cannot resolve image multiplicity, return pending_review.

required_evidence: Explicit comparison of the Ca framework, isolated PO4 arrangement and hydroxyl channels under a documented periodic mapping
Reviewer identity and a concise structural rationale; a formula, space-group label or coordination count alone is insufficient

allowed_only_if: Topology status is confirmed_apatite_like with recorded evidence
relaxation.effective_budget: Minimum of600 seconds and remaining per-candidate/global compute budget.
relaxation.convergence: Require actual optimizer convergence, finite energy/forces/stress and post-relaxation composition/geometry/topology checks. The filter includes cell degrees of freedom; atomic fmax alone is insufficient.
relaxation.implementation_note: Installed mattergen-evaluate / BatchRelaxer.relax does not expose a maximum step count. B must count steps in a bounded local wrapper; absent that wrapper, do not launch unbounded relaxation.

hull.required_method: MatterSim energies with the existing compatible TRI2024 correction and reference dataset
hull.label: ML-predicted screening value, not DFT stability
hull.identity: Use relaxed structure/energy pairs in original candidate order; verify coverage, corrections, finite values and identity.
hull.novelty_reporting: Report duplicate/known/new status separately. Rediscovery may demonstrate adaptation feasibility, not novelty.

decision.all_four_hard_or_geometry_rejected: End the pilot; no automatic extra seeds or relaxed thresholds.
decision.any_pending_topology_or_missing_hull: Report pending_review/not_evaluated; do not count as qualified or advance to DFT.
qualified_for_DFT_consideration_requires: Post-relaxation checks pass with confirmed topology
